items.subtype: predicate adjective after linking verb misrendered as noun
items.sentence: Sociologists have found that prolonged unemployment often causes individuals to become isolation from their communities and support networks.

marked_parts.A: Sociologists have found that prolonged unemployment
marked_parts.B: often causes individuals to become isolation

items.minimal_correction: often causes individuals to become isolated
items.answer_explanation: The verb 'become' requires a predicate complement; the adjective 'isolated' is required, not the noun 'isolation'.

items.subtype: infinitive modifying superlative noun rendered as gerund
items.sentence: The young volcanologist was the first researcher ever identifying the mountain's seismic pattern for eruption forecasting.

marked_parts.B: was the first researcher ever identifying the mountain's seismic pattern

items.minimal_correction: was the first researcher ever to identify the mountain's seismic pattern
items.answer_explanation: The fixed ordinal construction 'the first researcher ever' takes an infinitive of achievement ('to identify'), not a reduced participial form ('identifying').

items.subtype: subject-auxiliary inversion after a fronted negative correlative ('Not only')
items.sentence: Not only ethnomusicologists study traditional instruments but also examine the cultural contexts in which they are played.

marked_parts.A: Not only ethnomusicologists study traditional instruments

items.minimal_correction: Not only do ethnomusicologists study traditional instruments
items.answer_explanation: A clause beginning with the fronted negative correlative 'Not only' requires subject-auxiliary inversion, so the auxiliary 'do' must precede the subject.
